audit.summary: Archived assessment: Major. Recorded check: Decisive evidence: For kappa=6,a=1, x=-1/12 and x=5/48 both satisfy the raw sine equation and are below1/4. Radicands0 and9. The first cannot be a probability exponent at a=1.; Recorded check: Decisive evidence: At kappa6, a^2=4/sqrt3, printed covariance matrix/t=[[1,2/sqrt3],[2/sqrt3,1]], determinant=-1/3.; Recorded check: Decisive evidence: Printed p=gamma alpha/2-1 has range(gamma^2/4,1), disjoint from required(gamma^2/4-1,0).
limitations: P1 — Counterevidence: Equation (1.9) gives5/48. Theorem1.3's filled sine ratio yields a strictly increasing moment, hence a unique intended root.
P2 — Counterevidence: Preceding sentence calls a^2 a variance, suggesting omitted factors on diagonal. Replacing both diagonal entries by a^2 t gives determinant4t^2>0.
P3 — Counterevidence: Correcting p to gamma alpha/2-2 gives admissible negative exponents and exactly reproduces Proposition4.4 from p.36 sine formula.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
